scripts.text:
[Senior Tracker]
This is our advance base
to stop Morocc.
I'm a tracker
charged with leading my army
to Morocc's lair.
scripts.translation:
[資深追蹤者]
這裡是阻止莫洛克的先遣基地。
我是一名追蹤者，
負責率領軍隊前往莫洛克的巢穴。

scripts.text:
Your backpack is too full
I can't talk to you!
scripts.translation:
你的背包太滿了，
我無法與你交談！

scripts.text:
You need to reach level 160 first
to enter the Red Flower!
scripts.translation:
你需要先達到160級，
才能進入紅色花朵！

scripts.text:
[Senior Tracker]
We're nowhere near close
to stopping Morocc's resurrection.
I can't sleep at night,
knowing Morocc is doing everything he can
to recover his strength.
Could you come back tomorrow?
scripts.translation:
[資深追蹤者]
我們離阻止莫洛克復活還差得遠。
想到莫洛克正在竭盡全力恢復力量，
我整夜無法入睡。
你能明天再來嗎？

scripts.text:
[Senior Tracker]
I knew you'd return.
You look well-rested.
scripts.translation:
[資深追蹤者]
我就知道你會回來的。
你看起來休息得很好。

scripts.text:
[Senior Tracker]
According to my intel,
Morocc is hiding out in this place,
recovering his strength.
scripts.translation:
[資深追蹤者]
根據我的情報，
莫洛克正躲藏在這個地方，
恢復他的力量。

scripts.text:
[Senior Tracker]
Fighting Morocc
takes more than a few warriors, no matter how strong they are.
I recommend you join forces with
as many comrades as you can find.
Are you ready to enter the Red Flower
where Morocc is believed to be hiding?
scripts.translation:
[資深追蹤者]
無論戰士多麼強大，
僅憑少數人無法戰勝莫洛克。
我建議你儘可能多地
召集同志一起行動。
你準備好進入莫洛克據信藏身的
紅色花朵了嗎？

scripts.text: No.
scripts.translation: 不。

scripts.text: Yes.
scripts.translation: 是的

scripts.text:
[Senior Tracker]
Come back
if you change your mind.
scripts.translation:
[資深追蹤者]
如果你改變主意，
隨時可以回來。

scripts.text:
[Senior Tracker]
The entrance to the Red Flower
is not open yet.
Please come back later
and try again.
scripts.translation:
[資深追蹤者]
紅色花朵的入口
尚未開啟。
請稍後再來嘗試。

scripts.text:
[Senior Tracker]
The entrance to the Red Flower
has opened.
It will only stay open for a while.
You'd better use it
while you can.
scripts.translation:
[資深追蹤者]
紅色花朵的入口
已經開啟。
它只會開放一段時間。
你最好趁現在進去。

scripts.text:
[Senior Tracker]
This is our advance base
to stop Morocc.
I'm a tracker
charged with leading my army
to Morocc's lair.
scripts.translation:
[資深追蹤者]
這裡是阻止莫洛克的先遣基地。
我是一名追蹤者，
負責率領軍隊前往莫洛克的巢穴。

scripts.text:
[Senior Tracker]
After a painstaking search,
I've located
the place with the highest chance of
hiding Morocc inside.
scripts.translation:
[資深追蹤者]
經過艱苦的搜尋，
我找到了莫洛克
最有可能藏身的地方。

scripts.text:
[Senior Tracker]
According to my intel,
Morocc is hiding out in this place,
trying to recover
his full strength.
scripts.translation:
[資深追蹤者]
根據我的情報，
莫洛克正躲藏在這個地方，
試圖恢復
他的全部力量。

scripts.text:
[Senior Tracker]
Even though I've located this place myself,
I have to admit
that I'm not equipped to
explore it by myself.
I'm a tracker after all, not a fighter.
scripts.translation:
[資深追蹤者]
雖然是我親自找到的這個地方，
但我必須承認，
我沒有能力獨自探索它。
畢竟我是追蹤者，不是格鬥家。

scripts.text:
[Senior Tracker]
You look like
a warrior spoiling for
a good fight with Morocc,
and I think
you have a chance at winning it.
scripts.translation:
[資深追蹤者]
你看起來像是一個
渴望與莫洛克一戰的戰士，
我認為你
有機會贏得這場戰鬥。

scripts.text:
[Senior Tracker]
How'd you like to
enter Morocc's lair,
defeat him,
and become the hero
who saved the world from evil?
scripts.translation:
[資深追蹤者]
你想不想
進入莫洛克的巢穴，
擊敗他，
成為拯救世界於邪惡的英雄？

scripts.text:
[Senior Tracker]
If you're interested in my proposition,
let me talk to your party leader.
We'll discuss more details together.
scripts.translation:
[資深追蹤者]
如果你對我的提議感興趣，
讓我與你的隊伍首領談談。
我們會一起討論更多細節。

scripts.text:
[Senior Tracker]
Morocc may not have recovered his full strength, but fighting him still
takes more than a few warriors, no matter how strong they are.
I recommend you join forces with
as many comrades as you can find.
Are you ready to enter the Red Flower
where Morocc is believed to be hiding?
scripts.translation:
[資深追蹤者]
莫洛克可能尚未恢復全部力量，但戰勝他
仍然需要眾多戰士，無論他們多麼強大。
我建議你儘可能多地
召集同志一起行動。
你準備好進入莫洛克據信藏身的
紅色花朵了嗎？

scripts.text: No.
scripts.translation: 不。

scripts.text: Yes.
scripts.translation: 是的

scripts.text:
[Senior Tracker]
Come back
if you change your mind.
scripts.translation:
[資深追蹤者]
如果你改變主意，
隨時可以回來。

scripts.text:
[Senior Tracker]
The entrance to the Red Flower
is not open yet.
Please come back later
and try again.
scripts.translation:
[資深追蹤者]
紅色花朵的入口
尚未開啟。
請稍後再來嘗試。

scripts.text:
[Senior Tracker]
The entrance to the Red Flower
has opened.
It will only stay open for a while.
You'd better use it
while you can.
scripts.translation:
[資深追蹤者]
紅色花朵的入口
已經開啟。
它只會開放一段時間。
你最好趁現在進去。

scripts.text:
[Senior Tracker]
Finally you're back!
What happened in there?
scripts.translation:
[資深追蹤者]
你終於回來了！
裡面發生了什麼？

scripts.text:
- You relay
your experience in the Red Flower. -
scripts.translation: - 你講述在紅色花朵中的經歷。 -

scripts.text:
[Senior Tracker]
So Morocc got away.
That's a shame.
scripts.translation:
[資深追蹤者]
所以莫洛克逃走了。
真遺憾。

scripts.text:
[Senior Tracker]
At least
you wiped out
his army.
That's an accomplishment in itself.
scripts.translation:
[資深追蹤者]
至少你消滅了
他的軍隊。
這本身
也是一項成就。

scripts.text:
[Senior Tracker]
At least we know
where he is.
Could you come back tomorrow
and help me track
him down again?
I'll be waiting here.
scripts.translation:
[資深追蹤者]
至少我們知道了
他在哪裡。
明天你能回來
幫我再次追蹤
他的行蹤嗎？
我會在這裡等你。
